title: 会 vs 能 vs 可以 in Chinese: HSK 1 Grammar with Examples
description: 会, 能 or 可以? How to say "can" in Chinese: skills, being able to, permission, negatives, questions, the common mistake, and HSK 1 examples.
h1: 会, 能 and 可以: Three Ways to Say "Can"
lede: English has one word, "can", but Chinese has three. 会 (huì) is for skills you have learned, 能 (néng) is for being able to do something in the situation, and 可以 (kěyǐ) is for permission. All three go straight before the verb, and all three are HSK 1 words.

sections.h2: 会: a skill you have learned
paras: Use 会 for things you had to learn: speaking a language, driving, cooking, writing characters. 我会说中文 means you know how to speak Chinese. 不会 means you never learned how.

examples.py: Nǐ huì xiě zhège zì ma?
examples.en: Do you know how to write this character?

paras: 会 has a second meaning: it says that something is likely to happen, a bit like "will" in English. You will hear it a lot when people talk about the weather or make guesses about the future. 不会 then means "won't" or "isn't going to".

examples.en: Is it going to rain tomorrow?

examples.py: Tā jīntiān bú huì lái le.

sections.h2: 能: able to, in this situation
paras: 能 is about whether you are able to do something at a given time: whether you are free, whether something works, or how much you can manage. It is less about learning and more about circumstances.
So someone who knows how to drive 会开车, but if they are too tired today, they 不能开车.

examples.py: Wǒ míngtiān yào gōngzuò, bù néng qù.
examples.en: I have to work tomorrow, so I can't go.

examples.zh: 我的手机不能打电话了。
examples.py: Wǒ de shǒujī bù néng dǎ diànhuà le.
examples.en: My phone can't make calls any more.

examples.py: Tā yì tiān néng kàn liǎng běn shū.
examples.en: He can read two books in a day.

paras: 可以 is the usual word for asking for or giving permission: "may I...?", "you can...". 能 is also often used in questions like 我能……吗.

To say something is not allowed, 不能 is the most common choice. 不可以 is also correct but sounds firmer, like a rule or a parent talking to a child. When someone asks 可以吗, a short yes is 可以, and a short no is often 不行 (not OK).

examples.py: Lǎoshī, wǒ kěyǐ huí jiā ma?

examples.zh: 我可以看一下你的书吗？
examples.py: Wǒ kěyǐ kàn yíxià nǐ de shū ma?
examples.en: Could I have a look at your book?

sections.h2: Negatives, questions and the common mistake
paras: Make all three negative with 不 before them: 不会 (bú huì), 不能, 不可以. Ask a yes/no question with 吗 at the end, or with verb-not-verb: 会不会, 能不能. To answer, just repeat the word: 会 or 不会, 能 or 不能.

The most common learner mistake is to use 可以 or 能 for a skill. For something you have learned, such as a language, 会 is the natural choice. 我可以说中文 sounds like "I'm allowed to speak Chinese" or "I can speak Chinese if you like", not a statement about what you have learned.

examples.py: Nǐ huì bu huì shuō Zhōngwén?
Nǐ néng bu néng lái wǒ jiā?
examples.en: Can you come to my place?

worksheet.title: 会 vs 能 vs 可以 Worksheet: HSK 1 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 会, 能 and 可以 worksheet for HSK 1: 20 exercises (choose the right "can", word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 会, 能 or 可以
exercises.instructions: Write 会, 能 or 可以 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: Is it going to rain this afternoon?

items.zh: 我今天很忙，不＿＿去看电影。
items.en: I'm busy today, so I can't go to the cinema.
Do you know how to sing any Chinese songs?
I'll come back tomorrow. Is that OK?
This TV doesn't work any more.
My dad can't cook. He never learned how.
This dish is not bad.
He's ill, so he can't come to class today.
I don't think he'll like this.
Will he come tomorrow?

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: I can speak a little Chinese.
Can you come this afternoon?
May I make a phone call now?
It won't be very cold tomorrow.
You can't look at your phone in class.
answers: 上课的时候不能看手机。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: Do you speak Chinese? (Have you learned it?)
Will it rain tomorrow?
She can't drive.
Can you write Chinese characters?

items.zh: 老师，我会喝一点儿水吗？
items.en: Teacher, may I have some water?
answers: 老师，我可以喝一点儿水吗？
老师，我能喝一点儿水吗？
